title: CorpusManifest
description: Versioned publication manifest for one immutable source version. Content-free: records hashes of substantive content and metadata, never the content itself.

manifest_schema_version.description: Schema version. Publishers must reject manifests with unsupported versions before any DB mutation.

source_id.description: Stable, immutable identifier for the logical source (survives version changes).

source_version_id.description: Immutable identifier for this exact source version. Content changes require a new source_version_id.

canonical_origin.description: Git repository URL or other explicitly governed immutable origin. DB serving tables are not a valid canonical origin.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the normalized source body text. Changes when content changes.

metadata_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical metadata fields (jurisdiction, effective_interval, rights_basis, rights_holder, permitted_use, attribution_required). Changes when metadata changes; distinct from content_hash.

start.description: ISO-8601 date the source version became effective.

end.description: ISO-8601 date the source version expires. null means currently effective with no scheduled expiry.

origin_commit.description: Git SHA or equivalent canonical revision the source was compiled from.

reviewed_by.description: Identifier of the reviewer who admitted this version. Never a full name or email — use a role or reviewer ID.

canonical_locator.description: Stable path within the canonical origin (e.g. collections/employer/hiring/esah-v1.md). Used as locator_prefix in chunker.

rights_basis.description: Rights basis under which this source is published.

attribution_required.description: Whether attribution to the rights_holder is required on use.

global_state.description: Only 'valid' sources may enter a new active release. Withdrawal is represented here without deleting historical versions.

chunker_version.description: Version of the DeterministicChunker used to produce chunks from this source.

embedding_model_id.description: Embedding model name/ID. All manifests in a batch must agree.

embedding_model_digest.description: Digest pinning the exact embedding model version (e.g. SHA-256 of model weights or registry digest). All manifests in a batch must agree.
